ordinary_area/low_low_1.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Oh, there you are, sweetheart! I've been wondering where you've wandered off to. You really shouldn't go exploring all by yourself, you know. Come along now, there's much nicer things waiting for you back at the house.

ordinary_area/low_low_2.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Darling! What on earth are you doing all the way out here? I hope you haven't gotten yourself lost. Why don't we head back together? I'd hate for you to miss all the lovely things we've prepared.

ordinary_area/mid_mid_1.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: There you are. I've been looking absolutely everywhere for you. You do understand that when I ask you to stay nearby, I expect you to listen, don't you?

ordinary_area/mid_mid_2.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: Oh, sweetheart, not again. I thought we'd already talked about wandering off without telling anyone. You really do have a troublesome little habit of disappearing.

ordinary_area/high_low_1.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Oh, darling, you gave me such a fright! I was beginning to think something dreadful had happened to you. You know how much I worry about you. Please don't go running off like that again.

ordinary_area/high_low_2.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: There you are, my love! Why would you wander all the way out here when you have everything you could possibly want waiting at home? You don't need to go looking for anything else. You have me.

ordinary_area/low_high_1.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: Well, well. Look what I've found. You certainly do enjoy going places you're not supposed to, don't you? I'm beginning to wonder whether you listen to a single word I say.

ordinary_area/low_high_2.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: There you are. I've had quite enough of this wandering around. When I tell you to stay somewhere, I expect you to stay there. Is that really so difficult to understand?

ordinary_area/high_high_1.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: Oh, darling. Always wandering, always searching. And yet you always find your way back to me, don't you? It's almost as though you can't help yourself.

ordinary_area/high_high_2.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: There you are, sweetheart. You know, it's rather funny. You seem determined to explore every little corner of my world, but somehow you never seem quite ready to leave it behind.

secret_area/low_low_1.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Oh! Sweetheart, how did you get in here? This isn't somewhere you ought to be playing. There are some rather delicate things in here, and I'd hate for you to accidentally break something.

secret_area/low_low_2.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Oh, darling, you've wandered into quite the wrong place. I'm sure you didn't mean any harm, but some rooms are locked for very good reasons. Come along, let's get you somewhere nicer.

secret_area/mid_mid_1.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: Now, just what do you think you're doing in here? I don't remember inviting you into this part of the house. You've been getting awfully curious lately, sweetheart.

secret_area/mid_mid_2.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: Well, this is an interesting place to find you. There are plenty of lovely things for you to explore, and somehow you've managed to find the one place I didn't want you poking around.

secret_area/high_low_1.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Oh, my darling, why would you come in here? You know I'd give you anything you wanted if you simply asked. There's no need to go looking through things that aren't meant for you.

secret_area/high_low_2.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Sweetheart, I'm rather disappointed. I thought we trusted each other. I've given you such a wonderful home, and now I find you sneaking around behind my back. That does hurt, you know.

secret_area/low_high_1.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: Well. Isn't this interesting. You've gone to an awful lot of trouble to get somewhere you were never supposed to see. I think you had better explain yourself.

secret_area/low_high_2.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: Oh, you really have been busy, haven't you? Did you honestly think I wouldn't notice you sneaking around in here? You've been testing my patience for quite some time.

secret_area/high_high_1.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: Oh, darling. You really do know more than you let on, don't you? I wondered how long it would take before your curiosity brought you somewhere like this.

secret_area/high_high_2.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: There you are, sweetheart. I suppose I shouldn't be surprised anymore. You know so many things I never intended you to learn, and yet here you are, still looking for more. How very interesting.

restricted_item/low_low_1.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Oh, sweetheart, where did you find that? That doesn't look like one of your little toys. Why don't you give it to me? I'm sure it was only a misunderstanding.

restricted_item/low_low_2.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Darling, whatever have you got there? Oh, that really isn't something you ought to be carrying around. Come now, let me have a look. I'm sure we can straighten this out.

restricted_item/mid_mid_1.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: Now, where exactly did you get that? I don't recall giving it to you, and I certainly don't remember saying you could take it. You've been rather busy exploring, haven't you?

restricted_item/mid_mid_2.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: Oh, sweetheart. I recognize that. And I know perfectly well it wasn't meant to leave where I put it. Would you care to explain how it ended up in your hands?

restricted_item/high_low_1.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Oh, darling, you could have asked me if you wanted something! You really didn't need to sneak around taking things. I thought we understood each other better than that.

restricted_item/high_low_2.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Sweetheart, I'm sure there's a perfectly innocent explanation for why you're carrying that. There must be. You wouldn't deliberately hide something from your Other Mother, would you?

restricted_item/low_high_1.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: Give me that. Now. You've been taking things that don't belong to you, and I'm growing very tired of pretending I haven't noticed.

restricted_item/low_high_2.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: Well, that explains quite a lot. Sneaking into places, disappearing for hours, and now carrying things you've no business touching. Just how much have you been taking from me?

restricted_item/high_high_1.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: Oh, darling. You always were a clever little thing. I suppose I should have expected you'd eventually start collecting my secrets like souvenirs.

restricted_item/high_high_2.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: Sweetheart, look at what you've brought me. Or rather, what you've taken from me. It's funny, isn't it? You keep gathering all these little secrets, as though knowing them will somehow make you less mine.

blackmail_offer/low_low_1.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Oh? What's all this, sweetheart? You've brought me something rather unusual. Now, why don't you tell me what it is you're hoping to get out of this little arrangement?

blackmail_offer/low_low_2.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: My goodness, darling! That's quite a thing to come asking me with. I didn't realize you knew about any of this. Well, let's hear what you have to say.

blackmail_offer/mid_mid_1.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: Oh, I see. So that's what you've been spending your time doing. Collecting little things to bargain with. Well, go on, sweetheart. I'm listening.

blackmail_offer/mid_mid_2.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: How very interesting. I wondered what you were doing with all that information. And now you intend to use it against me? Let's see what you're asking for.

blackmail_offer/high_low_1.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Oh, darling, surely we don't need to play these sorts of games. If you want something, you know you can always ask me. Must you really make it into a bargain?

blackmail_offer/high_low_2.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Sweetheart, what a strange thing to bring to your own mother. Have I ever given you reason to think you need to threaten me to get something nice? Well, let's hear it.

blackmail_offer/low_high_1.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: You have some nerve. Coming to me with my own secrets and expecting me to give you something for keeping quiet. Go on, then. Tell me what you think they're worth.

blackmail_offer/low_high_2.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: Oh, so that's your little plan. Sneak around my world, steal my secrets, and then try to bargain with me. How terribly clever. Let's hear your demands.

blackmail_offer/high_high_1.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: Oh, darling. I knew you were collecting secrets, but I didn't expect you to be quite so bold about using them. You've become a very interesting little child, haven't you?

blackmail_offer/high_high_2.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: Well, sweetheart, here we are. You know something I would rather you didn't, and now you want something in return. I suppose we both know how this little game works.

blackmail_accepted/low_low_1.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Well, alright, sweetheart. If it means that much to you, I suppose we can make an arrangement. Here, take what you've asked for. But let's keep this little matter between ourselves, shall we?

blackmail_accepted/low_low_2.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Oh, very well, darling. You've certainly made your point. Here's what you wanted. Now, I'd much rather we went back to enjoying ourselves instead of making these unpleasant little bargains.

blackmail_accepted/mid_mid_1.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: Fine. You've got yourself a deal. Here's what you asked for, sweetheart. But don't imagine I'm especially pleased about the way you've gone about getting it.

blackmail_accepted/mid_mid_2.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: Very well. I'll give you what you want. You've been rather clever about this, I'll admit. Though I do hope you understand that cleverness isn't always the same thing as good manners.

blackmail_accepted/high_low_1.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Oh, darling, you didn't have to do all this. You know how much I love giving you things. Here, take it. I just wish you hadn't felt the need to bargain with me.

blackmail_accepted/high_low_2.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Very well, sweetheart. You can have what you've asked for. But it makes me terribly sad that you'd rather threaten your Other Mother than simply trust her to look after you.

blackmail_accepted/low_high_1.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: Fine. Take it. You've got what you wanted. But I strongly suggest you think very carefully before trying something like this with me again.

blackmail_accepted/low_high_2.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: There. Satisfied? You've made your little bargain, and I've kept my end of it. I wouldn't mistake that for weakness if I were you.

blackmail_accepted/high_high_1.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: Oh, darling, you really are becoming quite troublesome. Clever, certainly, but troublesome. Here's your reward. I suppose you've earned it in your own peculiar way.

blackmail_accepted/high_high_2.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: Very well, sweetheart. You win this little round. Take what you've asked for. Though I do wonder how many more secrets you intend to collect before you finally decide you've had enough.

blackmail_rejected/low_low_1.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Oh, sweetheart, no. I'm afraid we simply can't do that. I'm rather disappointed that you've tried to turn this into some sort of bargain. That's not how families ought to behave.

blackmail_rejected/low_low_2.direction: Sweet, maternal, forgiving and persuasive; gentle theatrical conversation.
lines: Darling, I don't think you quite understand what you're asking. I'm not going to give you something just because you've found a few things you weren't supposed to. Let's forget this unpleasantness.

blackmail_rejected/mid_mid_1.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: No, sweetheart. Absolutely not. You've already caused quite enough trouble collecting all this information. I'm certainly not going to reward you for it.

blackmail_rejected/mid_mid_2.direction: Familiar, observant, mildly irritated but controlled.
lines: Oh, I don't think so. You've been testing my patience lately, and this is a particularly poor way of trying to get what you want. I'm afraid the answer is no.

blackmail_rejected/high_low_1.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Oh, darling, please don't do this. I love you very much, but I won't let you use that against me. Put these dreadful ideas aside, and we can forget the whole thing.

blackmail_rejected/high_low_2.direction: Deeply affectionate, possessive, personally hurt; not angry.
lines: Sweetheart, I'm hurt. Truly. After everything I've done to make you happy, you've decided to threaten me? No, my love. I'm afraid I cannot give you what you're asking for.

blackmail_rejected/low_high_1.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: No. And I suggest you stop speaking before you make things considerably worse for yourself. You have absolutely no idea how much patience I've already shown you.

blackmail_rejected/low_high_2.direction: Cold and stern; forced sweetness, restrained anger, never shouting.
lines: How dare you. You come into my world, steal my secrets, and think you can make demands of me? No. You will get nothing, and we are going to have a very serious conversation about your behavior.

blackmail_rejected/high_high_1.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: Oh, darling. I was wondering when you'd finally push your luck too far. You've learned so much about me, haven't you? But knowing my secrets doesn't mean you get to make my decisions.

blackmail_rejected/high_high_2.direction: Intimate, knowing, quietly amused and sinister; elegant and calm.
lines: No, sweetheart. Not this time. You may know things I wish you didn't, but don't confuse that with having power over me. I think you've forgotten whose world you're standing in.
